topic: Milano Cortina 2026 Winter Olympics (6–22 February 2026) final medal table: Norway 18 gold, 12 silver, 11 bronze, 41 total — the most golds by any nation at a single Winter Games; United States 12 gold / 33 total, its best ever; Italy (hosts) 10 gold / 30 total; Canada 5 gold / 21; Johannes Høsflot Klæbo (NOR) 6 golds. Norway population about 5.6–5.7 million; USA about 340 million.
